plan.title: bug(lifecycle): .git/info/exclude blanket-hides xbrief/active/ on this clone — lifecycle artifacts silently untrackable

narratives.Description: This clone's .git/info/exclude blanket-hides xbrief/active/ so lifecycle artifacts cannot be committed without -f. The issue is operator-local, not a product change. Prevention detector is #3505. This story removes the bad exclude lines, keeps legitimate scratch entries, and records evidence.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`.git/info/exclude` on the `deftai/directive` maintainer clone contains a bare **`xbrief/active/`** line. Every xBRIEF in `active/` is therefore invisible to git on that machine — `git add -A` silently skips them, `git status` never shows them, and no lifecycle artifact created there can be committed without `-f`.

`.git/info/exclude` is per-clone and never committed, so this machine's lifecycle behaviour silently diverges from every other maintainer's.

## Evidence

```
$ git check-ignore -v xbrief/active/2026-08-19-3502-....xbrief.json
.git/info/exclude:33:xbrief/active/	xbrief/active/2026-08-19-3502-....xbrief.json
```

The file holds two distinct populations:

| Entries | Assessment |
|---|---|
| `WORKER-PROMPT.md`, `DESIGN-NOTE-3214-1581-ordering.md`, `allocation-context-3205.md` | **Legitimate.** Personal scratch notes — exactly what `.git/info/exclude` is for. |
| Eight individually-named briefs dated 2026-08-07 → 2026-08-09, plus the bare `xbrief/active/` line | **Problematic.** Lifecycle artifacts. |

## This is not a convention

Active briefs are shared, tracked artifacts:

- **406 commits** have touched `xbrief/active/*`
- **543 distinct active brief paths** have been committed historically
- #1358's recurrence record is literally *"An uncommitted lifecycle record is invisible to every other clone and re-surfaces as lifecycle-sync drift at the next release"*
- `verify:orphan-active`, `verify:completed-tracked` (#3264 / #3476) and the Phase 6 Step 2b sweep all read **tracked** artifacts
- A parent cannot monitor leaves whose briefs it cannot see — the swarm design assumes shared visibility

If per-maintainer suppression were intended policy it would live in `.gitignore`, where everyone gets it, not in a per-clone file that changes behaviour between machines.

The shape suggests escalation rather than policy: briefs excluded one at a time during a busy 3-day cohort, then the folder blanketed. That is inference — `.git/info/exclude` has no history — but the narrow date range and the ordering fit it.

## Observed consequences

- The #3502 brief was silently skipped by `git add -A` while committing its own PR.
- The #3476 brief "was never tracked on master" — it could not be.
- It materially amends **#3495**: that issue concluded the lifecycle gates are blind to *unscoped* work. On this clone, *scoped* work was also being made invisible before any gate ran.
- The #3476 invariant — untracked completed residue is not land — is defeatable on this machine before the gate executes.

## Remediation (operator-local; not a code change)

Remove the `xbrief/active/` line and the eight brief entries from `.git/info/exclude`. Keep the three scratch-note lines.

Prevention is tracked separately — see the companion detector issue.

Refs #3495, #3476, #3264, #1358, #1396
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want xbrief/active visible to git on this clone, so that lifecycle briefs can be committed without force-add.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit the exclude file at .git/info/exclude: remove the bare xbrief/active/ line and any individually named active-brief entries; keep WORKER-PROMPT.md, DESIGN-NOTE-3214-1581-ordering.md, and allocation-context-3205.md.
2. Verify with git check-ignore -v that an active brief is no longer ignored, comment evidence on #3504, and close the issue. Do not build the #3505 detector.

narrative.Acceptance: When git check-ignore -v runs against a file under xbrief/active/, it no longer reports .git/info/exclude matching the bare xbrief/active/ rule.
When git check-ignore -v runs against WORKER-PROMPT.md, DESIGN-NOTE-3214-1581-ordering.md, and allocation-context-3205.md, those scratch notes remain excluded.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: git check-ignore -v allocation-context-3205.md WORKER-PROMPT.md DESIGN-NOTE-3214-1581-ordering.md still match .git/info/exclude

narrative.Acceptance: When the remediation is done, issue #3504 has a comment with check-ignore evidence and the issue is closed.
When this story finishes, it has not implemented verify:lifecycle-visible; that remains #3505.
